items.title: Safety

items:
IMPORTANT: Summer reservations are Saturday-to-Saturday only.

Welcome to Villa Magnolia, a beautifully appointed beach home on the south side of 30A in the heart of Seagrove Beach, Florida. Located just one house off the beach, Villa Magnolia offers the rare convenience of a private beach walkway shared with only four nearby homes—meaning you can reach the sand in about 90 seconds without ever crossing busy Scenic Highway 30A.

The location is hard to beat. You’re just ½ mile from Seaside’s iconic town center, 1½ miles from Publix, and only minutes from The HUB at Watersound, Rosemary Beach, and all the dining, shopping, and entertainment that make 30A so special.

The Home

This spacious 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home is thoughtfully designed for families and groups looking to relax, reconnect, and enjoy the best of beach living.

Ground Floor
• Two private bedrooms, each with king beds
• Shared full bathroom
• Comfortable layout ideal for couples or grandparents

Second Floor
• Open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area—perfect for gathering
• Fully stocked kitchen with granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances
• Breakfast bar and generous seating
• A four-bed bunk room with a full bathroom tucked behind a private door—great for kids

Third Floor
• Primary suite with king bed, en-suite bath, and private balcony
• Additional bedroom with a full bed and private bath
• Twin roll-away bed and two pack-n-plays available for families with young children

Comfort & Connectivity

All bedrooms feature TVs (except the bunk room), with easy access to popular streaming services. The home also offers upgraded high-speed internet, making it easy to stay connected when needed.

Outdoor Living

Enjoy peek views of the Gulf from the second- and third-floor balconies, perfect for morning coffee or winding down after a beach day.

One of Villa Magnolia’s standout features is the private garage—a rare find along 30A. The garage is stocked with:
• Beach chairs and umbrella
• Beach and pool toys
• Charcoal grill
• Four bikes for cruising along 30A

Everything is available for your use during your stay.

Private Pool

After a day at the beach, relax in the home’s private pool and pool deck—a favorite with kids and adults alike. Pool heat is available for an additional fee, making this a great option even in cooler months.

A Personal Touch

We’ve been proud owners of Villa Magnolia for many years and truly value the guests who choose our home for their vacation. We work closely with guests to provide personalized service, quick responses, and a seamless experience—reflected in our many 5-star reviews.

We also partner with 30A Private Home Management, an outstanding local team that handles guest welcome, professional housekeeping, and on-call maintenance during your stay.

If you have any questions about the home or the area, we’d love to hear from you. Thank you for considering Villa Magnolia—we hope to host you on 30A soon!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
